text: Da Nang approves investment policy for urban area project worth $385 mln
The People's Committee of central Da Nang City has officially approved the investment policy for the Northwest Hillside Urban Area Project, located in Ba Na and Hoa Vang communes.

According to the Committee's Decision No. 5290/QD-UBND, dated November 18, 2026, the project will cover an area of more than 326.7 ha in the western part of the city, with a total investment capital of nearly VND9.9 trillion (approximately $385 million).
The project is expected to accommodate 16,020 residents, including approximately 4,560 people by 2030 and 11,460 people after 2030.
The project aims to develop a complete and modern urban area with synchronized technical and social infrastructure, environmental landscaping, and a full range of supporting services and amenities.

Planned components include a golf course, commercial housing, office buildings, and commercial, service, tourism, and accommodation facilities for sale, lease, or lease-purchase in accordance with current regulations.
In addition, the project will invest in technical infrastructure to facilitate the transfer of land-use rights to organizations for the construction of residential and other development projects.
The development is expected to provide approximately 1,052 landed housing units and 6,004 apartment units.

Under the current schedule, construction is set to commence in the fourth quarter of 2027, while the project is expected to become operational and officially begin commercial activities in the fourth quarter of 2032.
Da Nang authorities are currently carrying out procedures to select an investor through a competitive bidding process in accordance with Vietnam's Law on Bidding.
